name: service-mesh-debug
description: Diagnose and fix flaky e2e tests and connectivity issues in service mesh environments (Kuma, Istio, Linkerd, Consul). Covers 11 root causes: timing races, xDS propagation delays, Gomega misuse, pod availability races, mTLS/SDS readiness, Envoy circuit breakers, and outlier detection. Includes Python scripts for live Envoy diagnostics.

interface.shortDescription: Debug flaky mesh tests and connectivity issues
interface.longDescription: Diagnoses flaky Kuma/Ginkgo e2e tests against 11 known root causes and applies the minimal fix, and debugs live mesh connectivity (Kuma, Istio, Linkerd, Consul) with read-only Envoy admin scripts for xDS, mTLS and control plane health.
defaultPrompt: Use $service-mesh-debug to find why this e2e test is flaky and propose the smallest fix.
Use $service-mesh-debug to diagnose 503s between these two meshed services.
Use $service-mesh-debug to check xDS and mTLS health of this sidecar pod.
